create_reaction_by_id: create a Reaction object by loading reaction and adsorbate databases and selecting a specific reaction ID
create_reaction_by_string: create a Reaction object by looking up a reaction string in the reaction database
create_reaction_by_type: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting from reactions matching a given reaction type like dissociation
create_reaction_random: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting any reaction from the loaded reaction database
get_desorption_mapping: get an identity atom index mapping list for a desorption reaction reactant
